name: Salvation
description: An ancient primal force in the form of Squee's toy sphere, which protected his soul, speaks to him in the afterlife and grants him a choice.

timeline.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
timeline.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

timeline.summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
timeline.quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

timeline.summary: Squee chooses to return to life for one more chance, and Bulp, back from his errand, finds his king alive.
timeline.quote: "I wanna go back, Sally, but I only want one more.

relations.note: It chose Squee for its boon and protected his soul.
relations.quote: I'd chosen you as a worthy recipient of my boon.
